 Degassing Accessory 
Key features 
Documents 
Compatible instruments 
The Nova Degassing Accessory is an integrated, high-throughput degassing solution with eight degassing stations – all of which have two heating zones - and eight separate cooling stations. Everything is controlled via the instrument’s touch screen and Kaomi software.
Key features
8 degassing stations help accelerate your analysis
Eliminate the clutter, cost, and complexity of external degassing devices with eight integrated degassing stations while the other eight can cool down simultaneously. Prepare a range of samples within a vacuum or for flow degassing at temperatures up to 425 °C. Degassing is software programable and linked with an individual sample ID, ensuring full traceability.
Vacuum or flow - do it the way you want
The Nova Degassing Accessory can degas your samples using vacuum or flow degassing. This offers flexibility to users and saves buying multiple degassers.
Reduce costs with the degassing accessory
The Nova Degassing Accessory reduces the extra costs of external vacuum pumps, while offering a straightforward setup with no tools required. Even older versions of Nova can be upgraded with the Nova Degassing Accessory.
Anton Paar Certified Service
 Support throughout your instrument’s full lifecycle, wherever you are
Three-year standard warranty
Guaranteed original-parts and service support for at least 10 years after product discontinuation – plus ongoing lifecycle support
Instrument maintenance, verification, and optimization
Fast, reliable support from certified, factory-trained experts in 110+ countries
